assertion_analysis.failure_condition: The unconditional fall-through after the status=='stale' test drops any existing source with status != 'stale', so it fires whenever a hit's path already carries a source node whose status is extracted, skipped or failed (49 of 52 here); the same block also emits the fixed string 'existing source is stale', which is false for every one of them.

filter_hits is the filter the brief specifies; the brief (brief.md:17-22) drops only on unit mismatch, a stale source or a live holder, so a non-stale unheld source must be kept - the test that would catch the fault is 'a unit-matching hit at an existing extracted source is retained as a candidate', which the run has no case for.

population_delta is computed and dumped into the record but never asserted, so no coded check reddens if a restored name fails to leave its population; the delta is read by the worker rather than enforced, and the negative control at run.py:841-889 exercises only the unit branch, never the existing-source branch where the defect sits.

findings.text: blocking: the fall-through at run.py:290-297 drops every hit whose path already carries a StandardNameSource with any status other than 'stale' and records the reason 'existing source is stale'. A live graph read over the 49 distinct paths so labelled shows statuses extracted(41), skipped(6), failed(2) and zero stale, so every one of these 52 drops carries a false reason and the deliverable's required 'dropped with the reason' is wrong. The same branch contradicts the brief (brief.md:17-22), which drops only on unit mismatch, a stale source or a live holder: a non-stale unheld source is a candidate, not a drop, so 23 names (e.g. ion_power, size_of_camera, thermal_energy_confinement_time) whose only unit-matching route is such a path are filed under no_surviving_candidate instead of being offered to Jev, mis-splitting the lead_referral_total and understating the work the node actually had.

follow-on: normalise_unit (run.py:86-88) and its _DIMENSIONLESS set (run.py:79) are a fourth local copy of the dimensionless-unit authority the repository already owns at imas_codex/units/__init__.py:114 (_DIMENSIONLESS_STRINGS) and :155 (normalize_unit_symbol); the local set also differs (it adds 'n/a', omits 'none' that imas_codex/standard_names/error_siblings.py:41 carries), so the fork can disagree with the owner. spec() (run.py:373-380) likewise re-inlines the dd-source dict that provenance_rebuild.py:423-430 builds inline with no exported helper.

follow-on: the node's gate records the population delta but asserts it nowhere (run.py:672-675 computes and dumps it, no check raises on a mismatch), and the declared negative control (run.py:841-889) exercises only the unit branch of filter_hits; neither guard can redden on a regression of the existing-source branch that carries the blocking defect, so the recorded 'pass' does not cover the filter as a whole.

item_verdicts.goal: The source node's goal (brief.md:1-13) is to re-derive the 30 DD-search-referred dropped-edge names plus the never-bound names and restore each by DD search confirmed by one Jev Choice; the diff restores 5 (sib-restore-searched-sources-run.py:611-702) but the filter at run.py:269-297 drops every unit-matching hit that has any existing StandardNameSource, so 23 names whose only unit-matching route is a non-stale existing source (graph: extracted/skipped/failed) are reported as no-candidate rather than offered to Jev.
